messages:
samira: Heads up — noticed several service account keys are getting billed to the org default project when the request omits org/project headers. CS flagged a customer with a big quota spike tied to that. Anyone else seeing this?
henry: I saw a couple alerts this morning. Looks like the routing fallback behavior in auth-proxy changed in last week's PR (#4321).
mae: Can you paste an example request? Is this specific to SA keys vs regular project tokens?
samira: Example: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa_abc...' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — no `X-Org` or `X-Project`. Previously we mapped SA -> owning project via key metadata and left billing unset if ambiguous. The recent change made fallback to org-default for some paths.
nikhil: That would explain it. We intentionally set fallback to org-default for quota checks during the last rollout but forgot billing attribution should stay conservative. Bug in routing/billing path.
henry: Quick mitigation idea: make billing attribution require either explicit header `X-Billing-Project` or key metadata; do not use org-default fallback for billing. Quota routing can keep the fallback.
mae: Also we need better telemetry: emit `effective_billing_project` and `billing_claim_source` with values like `explicit_header`, `key_metadata`, `fallback_org`. Start with 1% sampling to avoid metric explosion.
samira: Console UX ask: show "Effective billing project" on the API Keys page and surface a warning badge for keys that currently rely on fallback_org. Customers should be able to override/set the billing project in the UI.
nikhil: I'll implement an opt-in feature flag that allows `X-Billing-Project: proj:...` header if the key owner sets "allow billing header" on the key in the console. Backwards-incompatible but opt-in.
henry: Plan: hotfix to revert the org-default fallback for billing attribution in auth-proxy -> deploy to canary region (us-east). Then reintroduce controlled behavior behind the feature flag, plus telemetry.
mae: We also need a backfill for historical billing aggregation — a migration that reads key metadata and reassigns billing for the last 30 days where fallback_org was used. Start with a dry-run and diff output.
samira: Suggested runbook: 1) Hotfix PR -> deploy to us-east canary 2) Enable 1% telemetry + logging for `billing_claim_source` 3) Console patch to expose effective billing project & owner toggle 4) Backfill job dry-run -> run after verification -> notify billing team.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary deploy of auth-proxy hotfix to us-east at 2024-06-03T15:42:10Z :rocket:
nikhil: I'll own the PR + feature flag, will tag QA and add the migration script draft to my branch.
henry: :thumbsup: Also add an alert: if `billing_claim_source==fallback_org` exceeds 0.1% of requests in a 5m window, fire pager to eng-platform oncall.
mae: Good call — I'll add the alert and a small dashboard panel for `billing_claim_source` distribution on the auth overview.
samira: Thanks — I'll tell CS to pause billing notifications until we stabilize the fix and confirm backfill behavior.
__notes: Single-thread slack export style: messages are one continuous string, all fields are flat.
